description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询可用的近源流量压制次数
title.en: Query available near-origin traffic diversion quota

descriptions.zh: > 该接口仅适用于DDoS高防（中国内地）服务。
descriptions.en: > This operation is applicable only to Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (the Chinese mainland) service.
